slots.name: seasonal visitors
slots.sentence: From December to March, some 25,000 people connected to the equestrian industry and as many as 9,000 horses migrate to Wellington for dressage and hunter jumper competitions, substantially swelling its population of 62,000 for the 13-week season.

slots.sentence: Horses are so important to the area that 9,000 acres have been zoned to prioritize a rural atmosphere and equine facilities.

slots.name: festival prize money
slots.sentence: Wellington, home to the 50-year-old Winter Equestrian Festival where stars of the sport compete for $16 million in prize money, is hoping to become a year-round destination for equestrians.

slots.name: project value
slots.sentence: The race for a competitive edge spurred Wellington’s village council to approve the $750 million development, from Wellington Lifestyle Partners, that will include homes priced from $5 million, expanded show grounds and a commercial marketplace with a boutique hotel, shops, restaurants and office space, plus some $10 million of traffic improvements.
